content.body:
Fortunately, the development of ever-thicker armor had been foreseen by German gun developers in the prewar years, and the PaK 38 was nearly finished when the inadequacies of the PaK 36 became apparent. Unfortunately the pace of change exceeded their predictions and the PaK 38, while definitely a more capable weapon, was already outclassed on the battlefield by some heavier tanks such as the Matilda II.
In every other way it was an outstanding gun being small, low-profile, easy to handle (despite it being rather heavy for its caliber) and incorporating a number of innovative design features.
The PaK 38 is a significant step up from the PaK 36, but still not enough to engage some enemy armor with confidence from all aspects. It is a very accurate gun, allowing you to aim at very small vulnerable areas from ranges of 750 meters or more.
CREW POSITIONS: 1 Commander 2 Gunner
